caption: The drawing depicts a lidded container, likely a decorative or functional vessel, rendered in grayscale pencil on a light beige background. The main object is centrally placed, featuring a bulbous body with faceted surfaces, a hexagonal base, and a similarly faceted lid. The lid tapers upwards, ending in a small finial, and is adorned with intricate, symmetrical foliage or scrollwork patterns, each panel of the hexagon bearing a similar design. On the body, a script monogram "HWR" is inscribed on one of the central panels. In the upper left corner of the drawing, a smaller, simplified line sketch of the vessel is shown for reference. The overall composition is clean, with the main object occupying most of the space within a faint rectangular border. The only text apart from the monogram is a faint signature or date “Emily Lorio. 1931.” located in the lower right corner of the image.
